descriptionChirho: The sacred chest or ark, especially the Ark of the Covenant containing the tablets of the law, carried by the Levites and housed in the tabernacle/temple.
A collection box or chest used for gathering money, as in the temple chest set up by Jehoiada the priest for temple repair funds (2 Kings 12).
A coffin or burial chest, as in the embalming and burial of Joseph in Egypt (Genesis 50:26).
